summary: Sunrise should keep a standalone municipal control row. Official city sources show an active Sunrise Police Department with its own chief, headquarters, dispatch center, and records/statistical unit; Broward Sheriff materials reviewed here do not show Sunrise as a BSO contract-policing city; and FDLE's official county-and-municipal offense reports publish Sunrise Police Department as a municipal agency row in 2020 and 2021. The current full-fill condition is therefore a reporting continuity / publication-ingestion failure on FL0062700, not evidence that the municipal target is invalid.
